title: Social Intelligence Data Infrastructure: Structuring the Present and Navigating the Future
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on social intelligence, which it breaks down into three pillars: cognitive intelligence (understanding others' intents, beliefs, emotions), situational intelligence (understanding social context, norms, culture), and behavioral intelligence (information sharing, social influence, open-domain conversation).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research. The analysis is centered on a broad, secular definition of social intelligence.
